scenes.text: A gift card feels like free money. For a lot of people, it's money they never spend.
scenes.head: FEELS VS REALITY

scenes.text: Hold on. Who doesn't spend FREE money?
scenes.head: WHO DOES THAT?!

scenes.text: A 2024 Bankrate survey: 43% of American adults are sitting on at least one.
scenes.say: A twenty twenty-four Bankrate survey: forty-three percent of American adults are sitting on at least one.
scenes.head: ALMOST HALF OF US

scenes.say: Average pile? Two hundred forty-four dollars.
scenes.head: PER PERSON

scenes.text: Add it all up... about $27 billion. In drawers!
scenes.say: Add it all up... about twenty-seven billion dollars. In drawers!
scenes.head: IN JUNK DRAWERS

scenes.text: And one in five has let a card expire. Ouch.
scenes.head: 1 IN 5 EXPIRED

scenes.text: How much is hiding in yours? Go look, because...
scenes.head: HOW MUCH IS IN YOURS?
